violations.text: The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. The only kitchen employee on-site is not certified through an approved food safety management course. All establishments that prepare/serve TCS foods must have an employee on-site certified in food safety management. SFSP does have an active FMC. New Violation. Correct By: 07/15/2026

Refrigerator door gaskets were observed in poor repair on milk cooler #2 in the cafeteria as well as the 2-door reach-in freezer in the kitchen. Refrigerator door gaskets shall be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 03/12/2026

The floors and walls throughout the facility have an accumulation of soil residue and/or food debris in the cafeteria area. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Food items were observed on the floor from lunch the previous day. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 02/12/2026
Refrigerator door gaskets were observed in poor repair on milk cooler #2 in the cafeteria. Refrigerator door gaskets shall be maintained in good repair. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 10/18/2025

The non-food contact surfaces of the air circulating fan in the kitchen have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. Non-food contact surfaces of equipment shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to prevent the accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 09/18/2025

The floors and walls throughout the facility have an accumulation of droppings, soil residue and/or food debris in the cafeteria area. The floor under the dip and dots cooler in the cafeteria has an accumulation of soil residue, droppings, and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Establishment is to clean any and all droppings using appropriate methods to clean and sanitize to monitor new activity. New Violation. Correct By: 02/27/2025
The floor under the dish machine area is in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 06/27/2025
The gaskets for milk chest #1 and #4 were observed in poor repair. Gaskets must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 11/16/2024

The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Establishment is to continue to clean all droppings using proper methods of cleaning.
